classification.difficultyReason: Design a simple five-sided polygon with two consecutive inward vertices while checking both interior angles are reflex and the boundary remains valid.

content.prompt: Draw a pentagon with two adjacent reflex angles.

answer.short:
One possible drawing is shown.

The two inward vertices are joined by a side, so their reflex angles are adjacent.
answer.worked: Draw a closed five-sided polygon with two consecutive inward vertices. Each inward vertex has an interior angle greater than $180^{\circ}$, and the two vertices share a side.
